parameters.name: Procore-Company-Id
parameters.description: Unique company identifier associated with the Procore User Account.

get.description:
Return a list of workflow instances for a workflow. Any resource using workflow should have a workflow instance.

See [Filtering on List Actions](https://developers.procore.com/documentation/filtering-on-list-actions) for information on using the filtering capabilities provided by this endpoint.

parameters.name: filters[workflowed_object_id]
parameters.description: ID of the workflowed object. When supplied with `filters[workflowed_object_type]`, the pair is resolved to the stored V1 workflow instance.

parameters.name: filters[workflowed_object_type]
parameters.description: Tool or V1 class name of the workflowed object. When supplied with `filters[workflowed_object_id]`, V2 tool names are resolved to the stored V1 workflowed object type.

parameters.name: project_id
parameters.description: Project ID. Required when resolving a change-order workflowed object.

Per-Page.description: Number of items retrieved per page

Total.description: Total number of items to be retrieved

Link.description: Link headers for the first, prev, next, and last link

becomes_overdue_at.description: Workflowed Object is considered overdue after

current_state_set_at.description: Workflow entered the current state at

workflowed_object_type.description: The Type of the Workflowed Object

avatar.description: The URL for the assignees avatar image

name.description: First, last and company name of the assignee

url.description: URL to perform the Workflow Activity

method.description: HTTP Method with which to request the URL

data.description: JSON to be submitted as the request body

status.description: Human-readable status. In the Show response (GET /workflow_instances/{id}) this uses the workflowed object's status text when available, otherwise the workflow state's status. The list endpoint returns the workflow state's status.

ball_in_court.description: Users the workflow is currently waiting on to act. Computed per instance, so each item in a list response carries its own set.

name.description: First, last and company name of the user

friendly_name.description: Human-readable name of the workflowed object's type.

terminated_at.description: When this workflow instance was terminated. Present after a successful terminate request; otherwise null. Matches `archived_at` on the instance.

terminated_by.description: User who terminated the workflow instance

id.description: ID of the user who terminated the workflow

login.description: Login/email of the user who terminated the workflow

name.description: Name of the user who terminated the workflow

permissions.description: Permissions of the requesting user against this workflow instance. Computed independently for each instance in list and show responses. Two instances in the same list can therefore return different flags for the same user (assignee on one instance, not the other). When serialized without a requesting user, every flag is returned as false.

can_view.description: Whether the user can view this workflow instance. True when the user is a company directory admin (company-scoped GET /workflow_instances), passes the workflowed object's VisiblePolicy (project-scoped GET /projects/{project_id}/workflow_instances), or can respond to the current state.

can_respond.description: Whether the user can respond to the current state. False for an archived instance. Otherwise true when the user is a company directory admin (REST POST /workflow_activity_histories), is a tool/domain admin for the workflowed object, or is an assignee of a current workflow user role that can act (GenericWorkflowActivityHistoriesController#create).

can_act_on_behalf_of.description: Whether the user can act on behalf of an assignee on the current state. Matches legacy UI: true when the user is a tool/domain admin for the workflowed object and satisfies the company's WorkflowAdminOverride settings (company/project/tool admin allow-list). When no override flags are enabled, tool admins can act on behalf.

can_terminate.description: Whether the user can terminate this legacy workflow instance. True when the instance is not already archived and the user is a tool/domain admin for the workflowed object who satisfies the company's WorkflowAdminOverride settings.

can_restart.description: Whether this V1 instance can be replaced by a new V2 instance for the filters[workflowed_object_type] and filters[workflowed_object_id] supplied to the Show request. This verifies V1 termination permission, the V1-to-V2 tool and object mapping, V2 tool enablement, V2 create permission, absence of an active V2 instance, and availability of a valid default preset. False when those filters are not supplied.

reason.description: A human-readable code providing additional detail on the cause of the error.

Enriched the list workflow instance response so each item includes the same
requesting-user `permissions` object as show (`can_view`, `can_respond`,
`can_act_on_behalf_of`), `current_workflow_state.ball_in_court`, and

instance; two rows in one page can differ for the same user. List
`current_workflow_state.status` is unchanged and still comes from the
workflow state record (show continues to prefer the workflowed object's
status text).

x-changelog.summary: Added permissions, ball_in_court, friendly_name and refined status to workflow instance show
x-changelog.description:
Enriched the show workflow instance response:
- Added a top-level `permissions` object with `can_view`, `can_respond`, and `can_act_on_behalf_of` booleans describing the requesting user's access to the instance. `can_view` follows company-admin / VisiblePolicy / respond access; `can_respond` follows company admin, tool admin, or assignee that can act; `can_act_on_behalf_of` matches legacy UI (tool admin and WorkflowAdminOverride). When serialized without a requesting user, every flag is returned as false.
- Added `current_workflow_state.ball_in_court`, an array of users the workflow is currently waiting on to act.
- Added `workflow.friendly_name`, the human-readable name of the workflowed object's type.
- `current_workflow_state.status` now reflects the workflowed object's status text when available, falling back to the workflow state status otherwise.
